status.main_product: Drone-based surveying and aerial LiDAR mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company directly provides drone-based photogrammetric and LiDAR surveying, land mapping, and geospatial data processing services under its own brand.
status.evidence: According to corporate registry data from Zauba Corp, Garud Survey Private Limited is an active company incorporated in Rajasthan, and its official website highlights the delivery of drone topographic and aerial LiDAR survey services across India.

claims.claim: The company reports employing modern UAV technology, including a fleet of fixed-wing and multirotor drones integrated with advanced cameras, GNSS/RTK systems, and specialized LiDAR sensors to generate precise 3D terrain models and high-density point clouds.

The company reports utilizing advanced DGPS-supported ground control alongside photogrammetry and geospatial software platforms (such as Pix4D or Agisoft) to orchestrate data collection workflows and deliver calibrated digital elevation and orthomosaic models.
claims.note: The utilization of Pix4D or Agisoft platforms by Garud Survey could not be verified in published sources.

claims.claim: The company reports the development and deployment of the "DEX Platform" (also referenced as the G-DEX customer portal), which is a cloud-based drone survey data management and online LiDAR viewer designed to visualize photogrammetry and LiDAR datasets, explore point clouds, perform linear/area measurements, calculate volumes, and compare multi-visit surveys.

The company reports providing advanced photogrammetry and GIS processing workflows to transform raw drone imagery into high-accuracy orthomosaic maps, contour data, DSM/DTM models, and 3D terrain outputs.
The company reports that its drone photogrammetry typically achieves up to 5 cm accuracy in X and Y coordinates, with vertical (Z-axis) accuracy ranging between 20–35 cm.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its drone photogrammetry typically achieves up to 5 cm accuracy in X and Y coordinates, with vertical (Z-axis) accuracy ranging between 15–20 cm.

claims.claim: The company reports that under optimal conditions, its river mapping workflows achieve absolute accuracy down to 1 meter and a ground sampling distance of 0.7cm/px.
The company reports deploying unmanned aerial vehicles integrated with diverse sensor suites, including RTK, PPK, LiDAR, thermal, and photogrammetry systems.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports that it allocates more than 29% of its total capital to internal research and development (R&D) to enhance its drones and automated, AI-driven drone data processing systems.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports that it actively develops and incorporates AI-powered data analytics, machine learning, and advanced sensor integrations into its surveying workflows to optimize tasks like automated anomaly detection and predictive maintenance.
claims.note: AI-powered data analytics, machine learning, and advanced sensor integrations for automated anomaly detection and predictive maintenance in surveying workflows

claims.claim: The company reports completing a volumetric survey case study across 6 active quarry sites for Minerva Mining Corp. using aerial LiDAR and photogrammetric mapping.
The company reports acting as an NHAI project partner for an 85km highway widening project, completing an end-to-end photogrammetric survey and BIM modeling within 6 weeks.

The company reports a track record of executing over 500 completed drone survey projects (out of 1,000+ total enabled projects) across various states in India, including regional service coverage spanning Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Uttarakhand, and Jammu & Kashmir.
claims.note: 1,000+ total enabled projects, and specific regional service coverage details (Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Uttarakhand, and Jammu & Kashmir) are not verified in official company metrics.

claims.claim: The company reports completing more than 1,000 projects, accumulating 10,000+ flying hours, mapping over 1,000,000 hectares, and collecting 30,000+ GB of data across India.
claims.note: The specific cumulative stats (1,000+ projects, 10,000+ flying hours, 1,000,000+ hectares mapped, and 30,000+ GB of data) are unconfirmed; official site lists 500+ projects completed and 1M+ hectares mapped.

status.main_product: Civil engineering consultancy and surveying services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone surveying and LiDAR mapping services under its own brand as part of its civil engineering and infrastructure consultancy operations.
status.evidence: According to corporate registry records from Tofler and the company's official website, Suncon Engineers is active and explicitly offers drone surveys, LiDAR mapping, and geospatial services.

claims.claim: The company reports performing drone land surveys utilizing the DJI Matrice 350 RTK platform integrated with the Zenmuse L2 LiDAR sensor payload, achieving spatial accuracies within +/- 5 to 10 cm.

The company reports executing autonomous flight missions at altitudes of 90 metres across project sites such as salt fields in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, capturing high-resolution overlapping imagery coupled with 28 ground control points (GCPs) for down-stream processing in Pix4D software.
claims.note: The specific number of ground control points (28 GCPs) and the use of Pix4D for this particular project are unverified in the company's source documentation.

claims.claim: The company reports utilizing PIX4D software to process drone data collected during a 1,500-acre high-precision LiDAR drone survey for a salt field project in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.
claims.note: The use of Pix4D software specifically for the 1,500-acre Thoothukudi salt field project data processing is unverified.

claims.claim: The company reports processing aerial drone data to deliver point cloud data, terrain classification, modeling, 3D models, orthomosaics, and digital elevation models (DEM/DTM) for infrastructure, construction, and mining projects.

The company reports that its drone mapping and surveying services leverage RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) or PPK (Post Processing Kinematic) GPS modules to deliver geospatial data outputs with an accuracy within 2–5 cm.

The company reports that it utilizes advanced unmanned aerial vehicles, such as the DJI Matrice 350 RTK equipped with a Zenmuse L2 high-precision LiDAR sensor, to execute technical final location surveys for railway station extension projects in India.
claims.source: Suncon Engineers - Final Location Survey for Railway Station in India

claims.claim: The company reports utilizing drones equipped with RTK/PPK GPS systems, high-resolution cameras, and LiDAR sensors to deliver advanced surveying, 3D modelling, and topographic mapping across multiple sectors in India.
claims.source: Suncon Engineers - Aerial Drone Survey Provider For Coal Mines, Iron Ore Mines
